scope: Static native perception calibration and separate autonomous development/test. Static authored held poses never count as autonomous grasps.
training_label: Final-second median of each recording's measured cup_fill_fraction; spatial column-top diagnostic retained separately. No fixed inventory-to-height target mapping. Legacy instantaneous scores unchanged.
strict_task_metric: Unchanged final-sample >=90% rim or source empty; correct stop, grasp, return and zero loss.
label_diagnostic: Spatial column tops are recorded alongside the unchanged old height. Compare retained inventory, particle trajectories and native images before accepting a revised training target.
